details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13 and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated script bundled as math_init.js. The script is obfuscated with a large encoded string array and a custom decoder, and contains eval, Function, and child_process usage. The package also depends on the sibling packages @or-sdk/base, @or-sdk/discovery, and @or-sdk/event-manager, which are known-malicious. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload at install time via a downloaded runtime.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
